def shipping_cost(order)
  domestic = order[:country] == "US"
  heavy = order[:weight] > 10
  express = order[:express]

  if domestic && heavy
    express ? 50 : 20
  elsif domestic
    express ? 25 : 5
  elsif heavy
    express ? 100 : 40
  else
    express ? 60 : 15
  end
end
